MINERAL REFERENCE — IRON

Compact iron-bearing inclusions with earthy ochre, rusty brown and dark metallic granules, naturally embedded.

Create only the mineral formations and their immediate contact details as a standalone design reference. The completed mcl_deepslate_deepslate.png texture is supplied separately for final composition and must remain unchanged outside mineral-occupied areas. Do not generate, depict, recolor, relight or redesign the host stone. Do not render a full stone tile; concentrate exclusively on the ore deposits.
